name: fire_impacts_experimental
methods: IPCC 2006 Eq 2.27 with explicit severity and fuel assumptions
Gartner 2014 Eq 3 gated on observed 15-minute intensity

evaluation.reason: No independent field emissions or sediment-volume labels available

limitations: CO2 sensitivity envelope is not a confidence interval
Terrain ranking is not deposit depth or safe access guidance
Hourly and daily rain cannot substitute observed 15-minute peak intensity
